dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: The Moonchase Festival is here, and Daddy still isn't back...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: The latest Masterful Chefs was super exciting. I've started learning how to cook, too!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Once Daddy gets back, I'll make him something nice for sure.
